summary: Retest of the iter114 action items at 6,303 products. Backend: the new test_iter115_retest.py passed 10 tests and skipped 1; the test_iter114_scale_retest.py regression suite passed 11 and skipped 2. Every p95 is between 0.08s and 0.26s, so nothing is near 1s. UI checks ran at 375x667. Items 1-6 PASS. Item 7 PASS after load, with 2 minor caveats. Item 8 had a HIGH regression on shop-home, which I fixed and verified. The admin Products part of item 8 has 2 new bugs (page change fetches twice; a search started on page N shows page N of the results). No deprecated Expo packages were found.

minor.issue: Groups by `sub_category` only. Products that carry only the legacy `subcategory` field (for example 2 Electronics rows with subcategory='Mobiles') match the sub-chip filter on /api/products but are counted in the '' bucket, so their badge can under-count. Suggested fix: group on $ifNull[sub_category, subcategory]. The pincode branch also skips the delivery_radius_mode condition that /api/products applies to store_pincode, so the two totals can drift for legacy vendors.

The ix_prod_text text index was added, but both endpoints still use $regex across 5-7 fields, so the index is never used. Search is fine at 6k rows (p95 0.11s and 0.26s) but will collection-scan at 1M rows. Use $text, or a prefix-anchored regex on an indexed field.

Every admin page load also calls GET /api/products (60 public rows) just to merge interested_count, so the INTEREST badge is 0 for any product outside the first 60 public rows. It costs an extra request on every page change and every 15s refresh.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTING AGENT. In about 2 of 3 cold opens or reloads, shop-home showed the 'No stores serving your area yet' hero even though page 1 returned 60 of 6,183 rows. Cause: load() ran ++loadSeq BEFORE the identical-key check. A duplicate call therefore invalidated the in-flight first request, then returned early, so products stayed []. I moved the key check ahead of the loadSeq bump and cleared lastLoadKey on error. Verified: 4 of 4 reloads show the grid, with exactly 1 page-1 request each time.

Each Next or page-N tap fires /admin/products?offset=X twice (plus /api/products twice). `load` depends on `page`, so useFocusEffect([load]) re-runs and calls load() again; this also resets the 15s interval.

ui_bugs.component: admin/products.tsx search while on page N
ui_bugs.issue: On page 3, typing 'PERFTEST Product 05' fires offset=0 and offset=500 for the search, and the offset=500 response wins. The screen shows 'Page 3 of 4' of the results instead of page 1. Cause: the focus-effect load() (stale page, declared later, higher reqId) overrides the appliedSearch effect's load(0).

integration_issues.issue: On one shop open, /api/products?ids=<same ids> fires 4 times, and /api/shop-layout and /shop-layout/analytics fire twice each. resolveBlockProducts runs both in cachedGet onFresh and after the await (2 per effect run), and the effect runs twice (lat/lng/currentUserId settle).

This works when at least one curated product resolves. But `resolved` is `Object.keys(productsById).length > 0`, so if EVERY referenced product was deleted the map stays {} and the dead blocks render as empty white cards forever. Also, while the ids request is in flight, a content_box whose product is deleted shows briefly as an empty cream card. Use an explicit productsResolved flag that is set after the ids fetch.

issues: single-picker-search-clear is an icon of about 23px (15px + padding 4), under the 44px minimum; add hitSlop as the multi-picker clear does

action_items: Review the shop-home.tsx load() de-dupe fix I applied (key check before ++loadSeq; lastLoadKey cleared on error) and keep it.

admin/products.tsx: stop useFocusEffect re-running when `load` changes, for example by holding load in a ref (loadRef.current = load) and depending on []. This removes the double fetch per page change and the stale-page search override.

shop-layout-renderer.tsx: call resolveBlockProducts once per effect run (only in onFresh when the cache was cold, or de-dupe by ids key), and replace the `Object.keys(productsById).length > 0` check with a productsResolved boolean.
subcategory-counts: group by $ifNull[$sub_category, $subcategory] and use the same store_pincode/delivery_radius_mode clause as /api/products.
Use the text index for q (use $text, or drop the index), and drop the extra /api/products call in admin Products, or fetch interested_count for the current page ids.
critical_code_review_comments: shop-layout-renderer.tsx (1,655 lines), shop-home.tsx (1,560), admin/shop-layout.tsx (2,108) and admin/products.tsx (1,252) are all over the 700-line limit and should be split.

Category screen header uses totalProducts, the server total, which includes curated products that `filtered` hides. The header can exceed the visible rows by the number of curated items on that shelf (3 for pincode 517644).

shop-home de-dupe: when load is re-created only because `shape` (currentUserId) changed, the skipped call keeps the first response, which was shaped with the old closure. That doesn't matter for buyers, but a vendor shopper may see their own products until refresh.

rca_of_issue: Shop-home empty grid: load() did setLoading(true) and ++loadSeq before the duplicate-key check. Sequence: call #1 sets lastLoadKey and awaits the request; `load` is re-created with identical params; call #2 bumps loadSeq to 2, sees the same key and returns; call #1's response sees reqId 1 != 2 and is discarded; products stay [] and the NoVendorsHero renders. Repro: log in as testbuyer and reload /shop a few times. Fix applied and verified 4 of 4.
